info.description:
Waitlists for the ProductCraft platform: create waitlists, take sign-ups from your own form (public, no key), approve or reject entries, run referral and A/B variants, and get sign-up events by webhook.

## Rate limits

Every `/v1` route is limited per client IP to 20 requests per second and 600 per minute. Each response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit-short`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining-short`, `X-RateLimit-Reset-short` (the one-second window) and the same three with `-long` (the one-minute window). Over either limit the response is `429` with code `RATE_LIMITED` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds.

tags.description: Webhook endpoints that receive `entry.created`, `entry.approved` and `entry.rejected` events, their delivery log and replays. The legacy per-webhook routes are deprecated.
tags.name: webhooks

legacy.secret_key: UTF-8 bytes of the whole secret string

x-pc-webhook-signing.rotation: space-separated `v1,` entries, one per active secret, current first
x-pc-webhook-signing.secret_key: base64 decode of the part after `whsec_`; a secret without the prefix (minted before it) is used as its UTF-8 bytes

post.description: A `entry.approved` event (Signups), POSTed as JSON to every enabled endpoint subscribed to it and signed with the Standard Webhooks headers. Answer with any 2xx within 15 s to acknowledge it; anything else, or no answer, is retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 24 h.

parameters.description: The event id: the same on every retry and replay, so dedupe on it. Part of the signed content.
parameters.name: webhook-id

parameters.description: Unix seconds of this attempt. Part of the signed content; reject a delivery more than 5 minutes from your clock.
parameters.name: webhook-timestamp

parameters.description: `v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<webhook-id>.<webhook-timestamp>.<raw body>">`, keyed with the base64-decoded part of the endpoint's `whsec_` secret. During a secret rotation it carries one space-separated `v1,` entry per active secret; accept the delivery when any entry matches.
parameters.name: webhook-signature

parameters.description: Only to endpoints carried over from the previous webhook system (`legacy_signature: true`), until its sunset: `t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<unix>.<raw body>">`, keyed with the UTF-8 bytes of the whole secret string. Verify `webhook-signature` instead.
parameters.name: X-Waitlist-Signature
